# FileSystem

`crescent.fs` · Read and write files. Relative paths are inside the app's own storage.

## Functions

### `appendFile`

```lua
FileSystem.appendFile(path: string, text: string)
```

Adds text to the end of a file.

### `createFolder`

```lua
FileSystem.createFolder(path: string)
```

Creates a folder (and any missing parents).

### `deleteFile`

```lua
FileSystem.deleteFile(path: string)
```

Deletes a file. Returns false if it was not there.

### `exists`

```lua
FileSystem.exists(path: string)
```

Whether a file or folder exists.

### `getFileName`

```lua
FileSystem.getFileName(path: string)
```

The last part of a path.

### `getFileSize`

```lua
FileSystem.getFileSize(path: string)
```

The size of a file in bytes.

### `isFolder`

```lua
FileSystem.isFolder(path: string)
```

Whether the path is a folder.

### `joinPaths`

```lua
FileSystem.joinPaths(first: string, rest: string)
```

Joins path parts with /.

### `listFolder`

```lua
FileSystem.listFolder(path?: string)
```

Names in a folder, sorted.

### `readFile`

```lua
FileSystem.readFile(path: string)
```

The whole file as text. "assets/..." reads the app's own assets.

### `readFileLines`

```lua
FileSystem.readFileLines(path: string)
```

The file's lines.

### `writeFile`

```lua
FileSystem.writeFile(path: string, text: string)
```

Writes text to a file, replacing it; creates folders as needed.
